ig_caption:
Mon, Nov 9: 2,600 deer reported statewide (2,023 antlered, 577 antlerless). Season total: 93,356.

Monday's 2,600 reports were the most of any weekday tracked so far, up from 1,988 the Monday before. A dry day with a 54-degree statewide high may have kept more hunters in the stand.
